ENGLISH: Master, classes at the university have not\nbeen going as I expected.
Teaching about the stars while knowing you\nmight be among them...
It is harder than I want to admit.
I know that’s what you wanted, for me to take\nyour place and carry your legacy.
Your hard stare over my shoulder,\nyour harsh and well advised words,
they made me who I am.
Thinking I could fail your teachings makes me scared\nto lose what is left of you.
My brother told me I should move on,\nthat this pain will end.
Weeks have passed and yet,\nyour last words still echo in my head :
Every star is worth being known
I swore I would, but right now...\nI might go back on my words.
But to know every star... This will take a lifetime
At least the night sky will always be here no matter what...
It has to be somewhere around here.
